title: Personality test
description: 32 quick statements. Answer as you are today, not as you'd like to be. It helps build teams and match the right Hero with each brand.
missing: Answer all statements to see the result.
notAllowed: The test is for people who work on the platform (agency, brand or Hero).
ctaHint: 32 statements, 3 minutes. Your team sees the result.

questions.e1: I gain energy from talking with lots of people.
questions.e2: In a meeting, I usually say what I think right away.
questions.e3: I like being at the center of the action and events.
questions.e4: I easily make friends with people I've just met.
questions.i1: After a day full of people, I need some time alone.
questions.i2: I prefer to think things through before speaking in public.
questions.i3: I work best focused and in silence.
questions.i4: I prefer a few deep conversations to many quick ones.
questions.s1: I trust facts and numbers more than hunches.
questions.s3: I pay attention to the practical details of the present.
questions.s4: I'd rather improve what works than invent from scratch.
questions.n1: I keep thinking about possibilities and what could come.
questions.n2: I like new ideas, even without knowing if they'll work.
questions.n3: I see links between things that seem unrelated.
questions.n4: I care more about the meaning of things than the details.
questions.t1: I decide by logic, even if it displeases someone.
questions.t2: I give direct feedback, without beating around the bush.
questions.t3: In a conflict, I look for what is fair, not what pleases.
questions.t4: I weigh pros and cons before getting involved.
questions.f1: I take into account how people will feel.
questions.f2: I look for team harmony above all.
questions.f3: I easily put myself in someone else's shoes.
questions.f4: I decide by what I believe is right for people.
questions.j1: I like to plan and stick to the plan.
questions.j2: I finish tasks well before the deadline.
questions.j3: I feel better with everything organized and settled.
questions.j4: I make lists and follow their order.
questions.p1: I prefer to keep options open until the last moment.
questions.p2: I adapt well when plans change suddenly.
questions.p3: I work best improvising and under pressure.
questions.p4: I start several things at once, as inspiration comes.

ISTJ.name: Guardian
ISTJ.body: Reliable and methodical: meets deadlines and minds the details.

ISFJ.name: Protector
ISFJ.body: Caring and loyal: looks after people and deliveries.

INFJ.name: Counselor
INFJ.body: Visionary and sensitive: sees the purpose and inspires calmly.

INTJ.name: Strategist
INTJ.body: Plans the long term and solves complex problems.

ISTP.name: Craftsman
ISTP.body: Practical and skilled: fixes things on the spot, hands-on.

ISFP.name: Artist
ISFP.body: Sensitive and creative: expresses values through aesthetics.

INFP.name: Idealist
INFP.body: Driven by values: writes, creates and stands up for causes.

INTP.name: Thinker
INTP.body: Curious and analytical: understands how things work.

ESTP.name: Doer
ESTP.body: Action and energy: closes deals and solves under pressure.

ESFP.name: Entertainer
ESFP.body: Charismatic and fun: connects with the audience instantly.

ENFP.name: Inspirer
ENFP.body: Enthusiast of ideas and people: engages and motivates.

ENTP.name: Innovator
ENTP.body: Inquisitive and quick: creates new ways out of anything.

ESTJ.name: Organizer
ESTJ.body: Structures teams and processes and gets things done.

ESFJ.name: Host
ESFJ.body: Welcoming and helpful: takes care of the mood and relationships.

ENFJ.name: Mentor
ENFJ.body: Leads by example and develops people.

ENTJ.name: Commander
ENTJ.body: Decisive and strategic: leads big projects.
